caseNameFull: Flick v. Johnson, Secretary of Defense
attorneys: Joseph S. Robinson, Earl J. Carroll, George T. Davis, Fred W. Shields, James D. Graham, Jr. and Dayton M. Harrington for petitioner. Solicitor General Perlman for respondents.
judges: Application, Black, Consideration, Granted, Should, Took

opinions.text:
United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
